name: clockoli-extension
description: Clockoli private GitHub-backed task time tracking browser extension

scripts.test: npm run test:clockoli && npm run test:timeline
scripts.test:activity:functional: playwright test test/activity-list.functional.spec.js test/week-navigation.functional.spec.js test/week-edge-drag.functional.spec.js test/add-time-ui.functional.spec.js --workers=1
scripts.test:timeline: node scripts/verify-timeline-build.js && npm run test:all --workspace task-timeline-component-clockoli
scripts.check: node scripts/verify-html2pdf-source.mjs && node scripts/validate-extension.js && node scripts/validate-release-inventory.js && node --check src/background/service-worker.js && node --check src/content/task-timeline-component.js && node --check src/content/github.js && node --check src/options/options.js && node --check src/reports/reports.js && node --check src/tasks/tasks.js
